editorNote: A headline-only day, again: insider selling at Rocket Lab, a reported Alphabet model delay and the lawsuit notices that followed, class-action reminders at Duolingo, Alibaba's gadget push and a broker note, plus gold and bitcoin commentary. Article bodies could not be retrieved, so details are limited to what the titles state.

stories.headline: Rocket Lab CFO Adam Spice sells $9.9 million of stock and exercises options
stories.summary: GuruFocus and Investing.com headlines report that CFO Adam Spice sold $9.9 million of Rocket Lab shares and exercised options. Only headlines were available; article bodies could not be read.
stories.whyItMatters: Per the headlines, this is an insider disclosure; the reason for the sale and any trading plan were not readable.

stories.headline: Alphabet falls 5% as Google's flagship AI model reportedly runs behind schedule, Stocktwits says
stories.summary: A Stocktwits headline says GOOGL dropped 5% after a report that Google's flagship AI model is behind schedule, and that retail traders are not worried. Only the headline was available.
stories.whyItMatters: The headline ties a single-day share move to a reported model delay; the underlying report and its details were not readable.

sourceLinks.title: GOOGL Stock Falls 5% As Google’s Flagship AI Model Reportedly Runs Behind Schedule — Why Retail Traders Aren’t Worried - Stocktwits

stories.headline: Securities class action over 'Alphabet AI issues' and a 4% stock drop is announced
stories.summary: A PR Newswire headline says Alphabet AI issues and a subsequent 4% stock drop triggered a securities fraud class action, and a GlobeNewswire notice carries a shareholder alert. These are law-firm announcements; the claims are allegations and the bodies were not readable.
stories.whyItMatters: A class action is a filed allegation, not a finding; the headlines do not say what the alleged misstatements were.
